contribution.note: Original 38-module Li proof development by aadrianvv in PR #35. Compatibility repairs and six extension modules are coordinated and attributed separately in issues #39, #40 and #41.

scope: The explicit 31-vertex tree is a tree of maximum degree four with a unique degree-four vertex whose only leaf neighbour is vertex 1, and is neither a spider nor a caterpillar. All 6,842 integer partitions of 31 occur as genuine connected vertex-block partitions. The actual set of all nonempty, disjoint, covering, walk-connected vertex partitions is in bijection with deleted-edge subsets and has cardinality 1,073,741,824 = 2^30. Exactly eight connected vertex partitions have type (3,2^14). For every finite colour type of cardinality at least 31, the full elementary coefficients at e_2^14 e_3, e_2^11 e_3^3, e_2^8 e_3^5, e_2^5 e_3^7 and e_2^2 e_3^9 are respectively 29, 83, -6304, -6800 and -8384. The negative coefficient proves failure of coefficientwise nonnegativity. The ambient object is the finite proper-colouring polynomial expressed using the inverse of MvPolynomial.esymmAlgEquiv. No separate infinite-variable symmetric-function ring is constructed. The closure contains the original 38-module contribution with compatibility repairs and six extension modules.
